samples.description: Pooled Compustat Industrial Annual firm-years t=1978–1986, using standard, consolidated domestic-source rows and keyed fiscal-year observations t−2 through t+1. Requires increasing actual DATADATEs, stable nonmissing reported CURCD across t−2..t+1, and a dated industry code from Compustat SICH or a unique effective CCM/CRSP MSENAMES SIC when SICH is missing/zero. Excludes SIC 6000–6999 and negative PM(t−1); trims |RNOA(t)|>1, |ΔRNOA(t)|>0.5, |weighted ΔATO(t)|>0.5, |weighted ΔPM(t)|>0.5, and |ΔRNOA(t+1)|>0.5. Final model complete cases only. Uses body period 1978–1986; the Table 2 caption instead prints 1976–1986.

assumptions: Ordinary pooled OLS with an intercept and conventional standard errors; the paper reports pooled regressions and t-statistics but does not specify the underlying estimator or covariance estimator.
Table 2 Model 3 is reconstructed with the current-period controls and tail screens in the build focus plus the stated in-sample |ΔRNOA(t+1)|≤0.5 screen.

Reported CURCD is required and stable across t−2 through t+1 for unit coherence; this is a construction guard, not a paper-reported sample screen. Stable non-USD currencies are retained; no conversion is used.

limitations: The prose describes Table 2 observations as 1978–1986, while its caption says 1976–1986; the body period is implemented and the conflict is retained.
The source leaves the pooled estimator and standard-error procedure unspecified; ordinary pooled OLS with conventional standard errors is a best-effort interpretation.

Rows without a resolved historical SIC after the date-matched CCM/CRSP fallback, including conflicting candidates, are excluded because the paper's financial-industry screen cannot be verified for them.
